description: Complete visual transformation of the Homepage (LandingPage.tsx) - the BIGGEST transformation. Cinematic, premium, immersive hero section with floating elements, particle-effect-like background, premium bento grid features, glassmorphism AI showcase, elegant stats strip, modern role pillars, and premium final CTA section. The homepage should feel like Samsung/Apple/Stripe quality.
steps: Read frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx fully to understand the current structure and all sections (hero, stats, features bento, AI showcase, role pillars, proof/results, about, final CTA).
Read frontend/src/styles/landing.css and frontend/src/styles/landing-auth-v3.css to understand current landing styles.

Redesign the Hero section in LandingPage.tsx: Add animated gradient background with floating geometric shapes (CSS-only, using ::before/::after pseudo-elements with animation), larger headline with gradient text effect (primary->tertiary), premium subtitle with better spacing, animated CTA buttons with glow effects. Add a floating stats preview or decorative element instead of or alongside the campus image.

Redesign the Stats/KPI strip: Modern glassmorphism card with subtle border, animated counter-style values (use CSS transitions), refined icon backgrounds with gradient fills, smoother spacing using 8px grid.

Redesign the Features Bento Grid: Add subtle gradient borders on hover, glassmorphism card backgrounds, animated icon containers with color transitions, better typography hierarchy, hover states with glow effects per the Stitch design language.

Redesign the AI Showcase section (Madarek AI): Enhanced glassmorphism chat card with stronger backdrop-filter, animated typing indicator dots, gradient avatar ring, refined bubble styling with modern borders, floating particle dots in the background grid.
Redesign the Role Pillars section: Modern card design with gradient icon backgrounds, hover animations (slight rotation + elevation), refined grid layout with better gap rhythm.
Redesign the Proof/Results section: Animated stat counters with gradient text, modern stat card backgrounds, refined citation block with premium quote styling.
Redesign the Final CTA section: Premium gradient background (navy->teal with gold accents), floating geometric shapes, modern glassmorphism inner container, animated dot accent, elevated buttons.
Update frontend/src/styles/landing.css with all the premium landing styles: hero animations, bento grid refinement, glassmorphism effects, floating elements, gradient backgrounds, smooth transitions.
Update the header and mobile menu styling: glassmorphism header background on scroll, modern burger menu animation, refined mobile dropdown.
Add keyframe animations in landing.css: floating elements (@keyframes float), pulsing glow (@keyframes pulse-glow), gradient shift (@keyframes gradient-shift), for the hero and decorative elements.
acceptance_criteria: Hero section has animated gradient background with floating decorative elements (CSS-only animations)
Hero headline uses gradient text effect (primary to tertiary color)
Stats strip uses glassmorphism styling with refined icon backgrounds
Bento grid cards have glassmorphism backgrounds, gradient hover borders, and elevation on hover
AI showcase has enhanced glassmorphism with animated elements and modern chat styling
Role pillars have gradient icon backgrounds and hover animations
Final CTA has premium gradient background with floating geometric shapes
All animations respect prefers-reduced-motion media query
Mobile responsive layout preserved for all sections
RTL layout preserved (using logical properties like inset-inline-start/end)
All existing links, navigation, and functionality preserved
verification: Read LandingPage.tsx and verify all Link/route references unchanged
Read landing.css and verify syntactic correctness and animation keyframes
Verify prefers-reduced-motion media queries exist for all animations
Verify RTL-compatible CSS properties used (inset-inline-start vs left, etc.)
findings: All visual transformations implemented via CSS-only changes in landing.css (primary) and premium.css (augmentation). No TSX changes needed - all decorative elements use ::before/::after pseudo-elements on existing DOM. Keyframes defined in landing.css (loads before premium.css in cascade). Premium.css augments with bento grid glassmorphism, AI showcase typing dots, avatar ring animation, final CTA floating shapes. stitch-canonical.css (later in cascade) overrides hero blobs for light theme specifically. Brace balance verified (0) in both files. All animations have prefers-reduced-motion coverage via global wildcard rule plus specific overrides. RTL preserved using logical properties (inset-inline-start/end, border-inline-end, margin-inline-start, padding-inline). The landing-final-cta-inner ::before/::after use position:absolute so they do not interfere with flex layout set by landing-auth-v3.css.
